name: Jetson AGX Orin 32GB (module)

sources.title: Jetson AGX Orin for Next-Gen Robotics | NVIDIA (Jetson Orin page, "Jetson Orin Technical Specifications" table)
sources.covers: CSI camera, PCIe, USB, networking, power and mechanical rows for each Orin module (the table's merged cells read column by column)

note: The AGX Orin series column (64GB, Industrial and 32GB share it): CSI camera "Up to 6 cameras (16 via virtual channels)", "16 lanes MIPI CSI-2", "D-PHY 2.1 (up to 40Gbps) | C-PHY 2.0 (up to 164Gbps)" (aggregate figures). USB: "3x USB 3.2 Gen2 (10 Gbps)" and "4x USB 2.0". PCIe: "Up to 2 x8 + 1 x4 + 2 x1 (PCIe Gen4, Root Port, & Endpoint)". Networking "1x GbE | 1x 10GbE". Power as the table lists it for the 32GB column: "15W - 60W" (power_w 60 is the upper end of the configurable range, not a measurement). Mechanical: "100mm x 87mm", 699-pin Molex Mirror Mezz connector, integrated thermal transfer plate; the height is not stated, so size_mm is null; mass not stated. Host fields for a Jetson: ports = USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports, stated_mbps = 10000 (the per-port USB 3.2 Gen 2 signalling rate, USB-IF; not an aggregate), lanes = MIPI CSI-2 lanes, gmsl_links = null (GMSL needs a deserializer board). practical_mbps is null (not stated). ingest lists each way in as stated (the CSI figure is NVIDIA's aggregate). The module data sheet (a download from NVIDIA's developer site) was not read; the figures are the specifications table on the page. NVIDIA's footnote: "USB 3.2, MGBE, and PCIe share UPHY Lanes. See the Product Design Guide for supported UPHY configurations", so not every listed USB and PCIe port is available together.
interface: USB 3.2 Gen 2, MIPI CSI-2 (D-PHY 2.1 / C-PHY 2.0), PCIe Gen4
